observed_parent_failure_before_registrat: In the frozen 2024-01 through 2025-06 parent audit, 15 of 23 trades stopped before a bank and 11 losing trades later had at least 6R same-direction horizon MFE. Seven more trades banked at least once but still finished negative. The parent lost 482.17bp/trade and underperformed matched random by 374.14bp.
hypothesis: Daily altcoin K1->K2 direction may remain useful, but intraday K2-wick invalidation is too fragile and a 20% total bank is economically incapable of protecting a reached trend milestone.
fixed_signal: Parent EMA13/SMA34 neutral-episode K1->K2 signal, recency 10, at least two transition votes, maximum K1-to-K2 gap five. No morphology, signal, universe or entry retuning is permitted.
development_data: 2022-07-01 through 2025-06-30; explicitly contains already-seen parent selection and audit and is used only to select execution parameters
one_shot_confirmation_data: 2025-07-01 through 2026-04-30; not opened by the parent and not used for parameter selection
selection_response: Half-year robust capped net R; clipping [-1.5,+10] prevents one listing-era winner such as ORDI from selecting the policy alone. Raw returns remain fully reported.
stop_factor: Compare intraday structural stop, 1.0/1.5 ATR intraday floors, one-close structure exit with intraday or close-based MA runner behind a 2 ATR disaster stop, and two-close structure/MA exit behind the same disaster stop.
bank_factor: Compare the parent 20% total ladder with 55% and 70% gradual ladders. Profit-taking and stop behavior remain separate sequential factors.
matched_random: Three controls per event, without reuse, blocked by same symbol, half-year, copied direction, and within-symbol ATR quintile; paired excess is sign-flipped at entry-week level.
